metadata.overview: Minimal directory-loaded plugin used by worker-runtime-v2 tests to prove per-device instance isolation: one telemetry channel and one command, both reading the ambient device module.

telemetry.name: status
telemetry.description: Echoes this instance's device.id/opts/env plus a module-level per-instance call counter and the shared debug module reference.

commands.name: echo
commands.description: Echoes params.value alongside this instance's device.id.
